segment.text: Usage Data. Data regarding your activities on and usage of our products, such as app launch data included in our services, including browsing history, hardware usage and operation history, product interaction, crash data, performance and other diagnostic data, and other usage data. Device Information. Data from which your device could be identified. Such data is collected through the devices you use, including your glasses, neckband, and other devices. Unless permitted by local law or with your consent, this type of data is generally not linked to your personally identifiable data (such as your name), and we do not operate an account system to require you to submit your personally identifiable data for the purpose of associating such data with your device information. The device information we collect includes: 1. The devices you use and other device characteristics, such as the product serial number (for products purchased by you), user agent, device or product ID (internally assigned ID and not associated with a specific individual device), product name, firmware version, MCU version, and DP version. 2. Device log information, such as log ID, log date, and type of log. 3. Information about the network your device is connected to, such as your IP address. 4. Device operational information, such as operational error messages, operational modes and mode transitions, and device activation. Transaction Information. Data about purchases of VITURE products and services or transactions facilitated by VITURE, including purchases on the VITURE official website, name, address, phone number, and email address. Location Information. Data about your approximate location, including the location of your device (country) and general regional information calculated from your device's IP address. Other Information You Provide to Us. Details such as the content of your communications with VITURE, including interactions with customer support and contacts through social media channels. Information from Third Parties. Where permitted by local laws and with your consent, VITURE may also obtain additional information about you, your device, or your service usage from public or legitimate commercial sources. For example, when you use services provided by third-party partners on VITURE devices, we may collect your device information and partial logs to assist you in authorizing or accessing certain paid features free of charge. You may also refer to the user agreements and privacy policies of these third-party partner services for relevant details.
